record.bible_text: The vision<WH02377> of Isaiah<WH03470> the son<WH01121> of Amoz<WH0531>, which he saw<WH02372><WTH8804> concerning Judah<WH03063> and Jerusalem<WH03389> in the days<WH03117> of Uzziah<WH05818>, Jotham<WH03147>, Ahaz<WH0271>, <FI>and<Fi> Hezekiah<WH03169>, kings<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>.<CM>

Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, O heavens<WH08064>, and give ear<WH0238><WTH8685>, O earth<WH0776>: for the LORD<WH03068> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>, I have nourished<WH01431><WTH8765> and brought up<WH07311><WTH8790> children<WH01121>, and they have rebelled<WH06586><WTH8804> against me.

The ox<WH07794> knoweth<WH03045><WTH8804> his owner<WH07069><WTH8802>, and the ass<WH02543> his master's<WH01167> crib<WH018>: <FI>but<Fi> Israel<WH03478> doth not know<WH03045><WTH8804>, my people<WH05971> doth not consider<WH0995><WTH8712>.

Ah<WH01945> sinful<WH02398><WTH8802> nation<WH01471>, a people<WH05971> laden<WH03515> with iniquity<WH05771>, a seed<WH02233> of evildoers<WH07489><WTH8688>, children<WH01121> that are corrupters<WH07843><WTH8688>: they have forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804><WH0853> the LORD<WH03068>, they have provoked<WH05006><WH00><WH0853> the Holy One<WH06918> of Israel<WH03478> unto anger<WH05006><WTH8765>, they are gone away<WH02114><WTH8738> backward<WH0268>. <RF>laden: Heb. of heaviness<Rf> <RF>gone...: Heb. alienated, or, separated<Rf>

Why should ye be stricken<WH05221><WTH8714> any more? ye will revolt<WH05627> more and more<WH03254><WTH8686>: the whole head<WH07218> is sick<WH02483>, and the whole heart<WH03824> faint<WH01742>. <RF>revolt...: Heb. increase revolt<Rf>

From the sole<WH03709> of the foot<WH07272> even unto the head<WH07218> <FI>there is<Fi> no soundness<WH04974> in it; <FI>but<Fi> wounds<WH06482>, and bruises<WH02250>, and putrifying<WH02961> sores<WH04347>: they have not been closed<WH02115><WTH8804>, neither bound up<WH02280><WTH8795>, neither mollified<WH07401><WTH8795> with ointment<WH08081>. <RF>ointment: or, oil<Rf>

Your country<WH0776> <FI>is<Fi> desolate<WH08077>, your cities<WH05892> <FI>are<Fi> burned<WH08313><WTH8803> with fire<WH0784>: your land<WH0127>, strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> devour<WH0398><WTH8802> it in your presence, and <FI>it is<Fi> desolate<WH08077>, as overthrown<WH04114> by strangers<WH02114><WTH8801>. <RF>overthrown...: Heb. the overthrow of<Rf>

And the daughter<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726> is left<WH03498><WTH8738> as a cottage<WH05521> in a vineyard<WH03754>, as a lodge<WH04412> in a garden of cucumbers<WH04750>, as a besieged<WH05341><WTH8803> city<WH05892>.

Except<WH03884> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635> had left<WH03498><WTH8689> unto us a very small<WH04592> remnant<WH08300>, we should have been<WH01961><WTH8804> as Sodom<WH05467>, <FI>and<Fi> we should have been like<WH01819><WTH8804> unto Gomorrah<WH06017>.<CM>

Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>, ye rulers<WH07101> of Sodom<WH05467>; give ear<WH0238><WTH8685> unto the law<WH08451> of our God<WH0430>, ye people<WH05971> of Gomorrah<WH06017>.

To what<WH04100> purpose <FI>is<Fi> the multitude<WH07230> of your sacrifices<WH02077> unto me? saith<WH0559><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068>: I am full<WH07646><WTH8804> of the burnt offerings<WH05930> of rams<WH0352>, and the fat<WH02459> of fed beasts<WH04806>; and I delight<WH02654><WTH8804> not in the blood<WH01818> of bullocks<WH06499>, or of lambs<WH03532>, or of he goats<WH06260>. <RF>he goats: Heb. great he goats<Rf>

When ye come<WH0935><WTH8799> to appear<WH07200><WTH8736> before<WH06440> me, who hath required<WH01245><WTH8765> this at your hand<WH03027>, to tread<WH07429><WTH8800> my courts<WH02691>? <RF>to appear: Heb. to be seen<Rf>

Bring<WH0935><WTH8687> no more<WH03254><WTH8686> vain<WH07723> oblations<WH04503>; incense<WH07004> is an abomination<WH08441> unto me; the new moons<WH02320> and sabbaths<WH07676>, the calling<WH07121><WTH8800> of assemblies<WH04744>, I cannot away with<WH03201><WTH8799>; <FI>it is<Fi> iniquity<WH0205>, even the solemn meeting<WH06116>. <RF>iniquity: or, grief<Rf>

Your new moons<WH02320> and your appointed feasts<WH04150> my soul<WH05315> hateth<WH08130><WTH8804>: they are a trouble<WH02960> unto me; I am weary<WH03811><WTH8738> to bear<WH05375><WTH8800> <FI>them<Fi> .

And when ye spread forth<WH06566><WTH8763> your hands<WH03709>, I will hide<WH05956><WTH8686> mine eyes<WH05869> from you: yea, when ye make many<WH07235><WTH8686> prayers<WH08605>, I will not hear<WH08085><WTH8802>: your hands<WH03027> are full<WH04390><WTH8804> of blood<WH01818>. <RF>make...: Heb. multiply prayer<Rf> <RF>blood: Heb. bloods<Rf><CM>

Wash<WH07364><WTH8798> you, make you clean<WH02135><WTH8690>; put away<WH05493><WTH8685> the evil<WH07455> of your doings<WH04611> from before<WH05048> mine eyes<WH05869>; cease<WH02308><WTH8798> to do evil<WH07489><WTH8687>;

Learn<WH03925><WTH8798> to do well<WH03190><WTH8687>; seek<WH01875><WTH8798> judgment<WH04941>, relieve<WH0833><WTH8761> the oppressed<WH02541>, judge<WH08199><WTH8798> the fatherless<WH03490>, plead<WH07378><WTH8798> for the widow<WH0490>. <RF>relieve: or, righten<Rf>

Come now<WH03212><WTH8798>, and let us reason together<WH03198><WTH8735>, saith<WH0559><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068>: though your sins<WH02399> be as scarlet<WH08144>, they shall be as white<WH03835><WTH8686> as snow<WH07950>; though they be red<WH0119><WTH8686> like crimson<WH08438>, they shall be as wool<WH06785>.
If ye be willing<WH014><WTH8799> and obedient<WH08085><WTH8804>, ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the good<WH02898> of the land<WH0776>:

But if ye refuse<WH03985><WTH8762> and rebel<WH04784><WTH8804>, ye shall be devoured<WH0398><WTH8792> with the sword<WH02719>: for the mouth<WH06310> of the LORD<WH03068> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> .<CM>

How is the faithful<WH0539><WTH8737> city<WH07151> become an harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>! it was full<WH04392> of judgment<WH04941>; righteousness<WH06664> lodged<WH03885><WTH8799> in it; but now murderers<WH07523><WTH8764>.
Thy silver<WH03701> is become dross<WH05509>, thy wine<WH05435> mixed<WH04107><WTH8803> with water<WH04325>:

Thy princes<WH08269> <FI>are<Fi> rebellious<WH05637><WTH8802>, and companions<WH02270> of thieves<WH01590>: every one loveth<WH0157><WTH8802> gifts<WH07810>, and followeth<WH07291><WTH8802> after rewards<WH08021>: they judge<WH08199><WTH8799> not the fatherless<WH03490>, neither doth the cause<WH07379> of the widow<WH0490> come<WH0935><WTH8799> unto them.

Therefore saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0113>, the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, the mighty One<WH046> of Israel<WH03478>, Ah<WH01945>, I will ease<WH05162><WTH8735> me of mine adversaries<WH06862>, and avenge<WH05358><WTH8735> me of mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>:

And I will turn<WH07725><WTH8686> my hand<WH03027> upon thee, and purely<WH01253> purge away<WH06884><WTH8799> thy dross<WH05509>, and take away<WH05493><WTH8686> all thy tin<WH0913>: <RF>purely: Heb. according to pureness<Rf>

And I will restore<WH07725><WTH8686> thy judges<WH08199><WTH8802> as at the first<WH07223>, and thy counsellors<WH03289><WTH8802> as at the beginning<WH08462>: afterward<WH0310> thou shalt be called<WH07121><WTH8735>, The city<WH05892> of righteousness<WH06664>, the faithful<WH0539><WTH8737> city<WH07151>.
Zion<WH06726> shall be redeemed<WH06299><WTH8735> with judgment<WH04941>, and her converts<WH07725><WTH8802> with righteousness<WH06666>. <RF>her...: or, they that return of her<Rf>

And the destruction<WH07667> of the transgressors<WH06586><WTH8802> and of the sinners<WH02400> <FI>shall be<Fi> together<WH03162>, and they that forsake<WH05800><WTH8802> the LORD<WH03068> shall be consumed<WH03615><WTH8799>. <RF>destruction: Heb. breaking<Rf>

For they shall be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> of the oaks<WH0352> which ye have desired<WH02530><WTH8804>, and ye shall be confounded<WH02659><WTH8799> for the gardens<WH01593> that ye have chosen<WH0977><WTH8804>.
For ye shall be as an oak<WH0424> whose leaf<WH05929> fadeth<WH05034><WTH8802>, and as a garden<WH01593> that hath no water<WH04325>.

And the strong<WH02634> shall be as tow<WH05296>, and the maker<WH06467> of it as a spark<WH05213>, and they shall both<WH08147> burn<WH01197><WTH8804> together<WH03162>, and none shall quench<WH03518><WTH8764> <FI>them<Fi> . <RF>maker...: or, and his work<Rf><CM>
